---
name: Sample Request
about: Report a missing or broken malware sample in the catalog
labels: sample
---

> **Do NOT open a sample request here.**
>
> As stated in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md), sample requests must be sent by email
> to [thezoo+codeofconduct@morirt.com](mailto:thezoo+codeofconduct@morirt.com).
>
> Issues opened for sample requests will be closed without response.

---

If you found a **broken or mismatched** existing sample (wrong hash, wrong password, wrong archive format),
please use the **Bug Report** template instead and include:

- Sample name / ID
- Expected hash (if known)
- What is broken (password does not work, file is corrupted, path mismatch, etc.)
